content:
oliver: Security advisory — discovered long-lived Google service account JSON keys in a public S3 snapshot. We have no evidence of active exfiltration, but per policy we must rotate all user-managed JSON keys and disable legacy key usage. Deadline: 2026-04-05 23:59 UTC.

security-bot: Automated scan summary: 6 service accounts with user-managed JSON keys older than 90 days across prod projects (prod-core, prod-analytics). Full list posted to the secure ticket RW-Sec-876.

rachel: Ack. Is the action just rotate keys, or also revoke and replace with workload identity where possible?

oliver: Both. Primary actions:
- Rotate keys for any service account that must keep JSON keys (only short-lived keys going forward)
- Migrate apps to Workload Identity Federation or workload identity pools where feasible
- Disable creation of new user-managed JSON keys by org policy after migration

pete: I own prod-analytics integrations that still use JSON keys (export jobs). I'll put up a maintenance PR to move them to Workload Identity by next week.

infra-oncall: Recommend immediate short-term step: issue new keys and signal owners to swap creds by 2026-04-03, then revoke old keys on 2026-04-05. Need owners to subscribe to the revoke window.

security-bot: Helpful commands (examples):
```bash
# list keys for a service account
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=my-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format=json
# create a new key (use only if necessary)
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=my-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# delete an old key by id
KEY_ID=abcdef1234567890
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete $KEY_ID --iam-account=my-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

sara: To avoid churn: owners who can migrate to Workload Identity should do so ASAP; I'll add migration runbooks to the infra docs and host a 30-min office hours tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Link: https://tinyurl.com/rw-wi-office-hours

rachel: Quick checklist for owners to post in this thread after swap: `owner: service - sa: name - action: rotated/migrated - old_keys_revoked: yes/no - notes`

pete: owner: analytics-exporter - sa: analytics-exporter@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com - action: migrated - old_keys_revoked: yes - notes: switched to Workload Identity, CI updated, verified exports.

oliver: owner: backup-uploader - sa: backup-uploader@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com - action: rotated - old_keys_revoked: pending - notes: new key issued, rollout window 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC.

security-bot: Org policy update planned: restrict iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation to prevent future user-managed key creation for prod projects. This requires a config change and will be scheduled after migrations.

pm-bot: Tracking ticket created RW-Sec-876 with checklist and owner assignments. Please link any follow-up PRs here.

infra-oncall: Reminder: if you use hashed/key fingerprints in config, update them. Some SDKs cache keys; restart pods after secret swap.

oliver: If you cannot complete migration by the deadline, mark `old_keys_revoked: no` with reasons. We will request an exception but expect a concrete plan.

rachel: owner: notification-service - sa: notify@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com - action: rotated - old_keys_revoked: yes - notes: rotation done, canaries ok.

sara: Office hours will cover sample Terraform changes and GKE workload identity bindings. Bring specific service accounts if you need help.

oliver: Closing notes: after 2026-04-05 we will revoke remaining old keys and lock down key creation. Thanks for quick action. :shield:
